knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A straight-on dial photo so date centering in the window can be discussed.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Cyclops magnification in person or how centering looks at other wrist angles.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A straight-on date-window photo so cyclops alignment can be discussed. Minor alignment variation appears in curated notes; it is not proof of a defect in submitted photos.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the cyclops magnifies in person, or how alignment reads at other wrist angles.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A straight-on dial photo in even light. Green dial appearance changes significantly with lighting.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the dial reads on the wrist in mixed light, or color match to a buyer's expectation.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A rehaut photo that shows inner-ring alignment relative to the dial.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Whether alignment holds after shipping or after the crystal is disturbed.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Photos of solid end-link fit against the case lugs.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Gap feel on the wrist or how the bracelet sits after a few weeks of wear.
